title: Very thin stainless, plastic handle got hot, tea had a awful taste!
text:
Very thin stainless, plastic handle got hot, tea had a awful taste!. I was excited to get this small Primula Stewart tea kettle.
It is cute, and I like that its easy to clean the inside.
The kettel is VERY light , and the handle is plastic, as is the knob on the lid, and the whistle!
That was disappointing!
Also the handle does get hot , and I had to use a pot holder on it,

Before using it, I washed it with soap, using my kitchen brush. Then put water in and put it on my gas stove.
After the first boil, I washed it again,, filled it , boiled water again. The whistle was strong, which I like.
Then I made made tea. I put in filtered water.
The tea I usually use tasted Awful! .
I washed it again, made Tea again, the taste for some odd reason was not good, my husband agreed.
When I looked inside both times I noticed some type of flim foating on the top of the water!

This kettle said it was stainless, if it is its a low grade I think.
The bottom is very thin, and seems to be the same thin stainless the kettle is.
I have other another stainless tea kettle that is more then twice as heavy.
I would not even use the poor quality to use camping, or put in our Rv.
Very poor Quality.

I'm only giving this a 2 star for easy cleaning, and strong whistle.
I’ll be using this for a planter

product_metadata.title: Primula Stewart Whistling Stovetop Tea Kettle Food Grade Stainless Steel, Hot Water Fast to Boil, Cool Touch Folding, 1.5-Quart, Brushed with Black Handle
features: PREMIUM KETTLE BUILT FOR PERFORMANCE- The Stewart tea kettle is made of durable, food grade stainless steel that will last.
EASY TO USE- This kettle will boil water in no time and features a flip-up whistling spout that easily opens when it’s time to pour.
SIMPLE TO STORE: The folding handle makes it easy to store this kettle in a cabinet, drawer or pantry.
EASY TO CLEAN- The wide mouth lid of the kettle makes cleaning a simple task, leaving enough room to easily empty and wipe dry the kettle between uses. It's that easy.

LARGE CAPACITY- Great for entertaining and serving family and friends, the large capacity is perfect for making multiple cups of coffee or tea. The comfortable cool touch handle is easy to hold and grasp and makes serving safe and easy
description: Add style and function to your kitchen with this attractive stovetop water kettle from Primula. Like classic whistling tea kettles, the Stewart emits a pleasant whistle to alert you that your water is boiling. The Stewart Whistling Kettle is sturdily designed and constructed, and sports a timeless design to suit any decor from traditional to modern. The spout opens easily with just a quick flip. The handle features a stay cool coating that protects your hand from the heat, and folds down for easy storage in tight spaces. The classic shape and brushed stainless steel finish make this kettle a gorgeous addition to your kitchen.
